props.heading: You decide what we remember.
props.intro: Four categories, plainly named. Change them whenever you like — the choice is stored on this device only, and nothing outside Essential runs until you allow it.

categories.title: Essential
categories.text: Keeps your basket, your sign-in and your security working. These cannot be switched off.

categories.title: Preferences
categories.text: Remembers your shade, skin concerns and saved pieces so the gallery opens where you left it.

categories.title: Analytics
categories.text: Anonymous page counts that show us where a journey stalls. Never linked to your name or sold.

categories.title: Marketing
categories.text: Lets us show you our pieces elsewhere and measure whether that was welcome.
